adjudication.rationale: The diff shows essentially the same “if credential not in memory, fetch it from DB” logic duplicated in multiple places with already-different implementations. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, missing credentials are fetched via `prisma.credential.findUnique({ include: { app: { select: { slug: true }}}})` and then reshaped into a `CredentialWithAppName`-like object (setting `appName` from `app.slug`, copying fields). A very similar block exists in `updateAllCalendarEvents` (the updated booking references loop) with the same include+reshape pattern. In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts`, a third copy exists, but it uses `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId }})` (no `app` include / slug validation) and assigns the Prisma credential directly, not reshaping to match the EventManager path. This is a concrete maintainability/consistency issue introduced by the change (array destination calendars leading to more credential resolution paths), even if it’s not an immediately provable runtime defect from the diff alone.
